authorshipMethod.summary: Original objectives, neutral taxonomy, three-trail sequence, constraints and prerequisite links were written before concept-level comparison with the listed official benchmarks.
authorshipMethod.levelChoice: Twenty-one levels create a regular three-trail rhythm in each of seven learner bands.
authorshipMethod.skillChoice: Six coherent mastery checkpoints per level give 126 skills; every checkpoint declares the task types that must be witnessed for mastery.
authorshipMethod.wordingPolicy: No benchmark sentence is reproduced. England ids identify named year/domain sections and AC9 ids are stable Australian Curriculum Version 9 content-description codes.

bands.title: Pre-K Foundations
bands.purpose: Build attention to amount, attributes, order and repeat through play with small collections.

bands.title: Kindergarten
bands.purpose: Connect small quantities to numerals, parts, actions, shapes, measures and simple evidence.

bands.title: Grade 1
bands.purpose: Develop two-digit structure, facts within twenty and useful everyday representations.

bands.title: Grade 2
bands.purpose: Extend place value to one thousand while linking operations, fractions, metric measures and data.

bands.title: Grade 3
bands.purpose: Use regrouping, fact families, fractions and measurement in connected problems.

bands.title: Grade 4
bands.purpose: Coordinate efficient operations with decimals, equivalence, area, symmetry and investigations.

bands.title: Grade 5
bands.purpose: Model with large numbers, rational forms, factors, metric measures, geometry and evidence.

phaseLegend.A: abstract notation, generalisation or symbolic reasoning

constraintConventions.rule: Profiles select a semantic runtime; constraints carry ranges, units, denominations, representations and variation policies.

levels.title: Match and Notice
levels.purpose: Coordinate objects, tiny amounts, order and a two-part repeat.

levels.title: Small-Set Workshop
levels.purpose: Name, compare and compose collections through five.

levels.title: Change and Story
levels.purpose: Act out small changes, shares, positions and records.

levels.title: Ten Lab
levels.purpose: Connect quantities through ten to parts, comparisons and shapes.

levels.title: Twenty Path
levels.purpose: Extend ordered number, notation and early equations through twenty.

levels.title: World Records
levels.purpose: Use grouping, routes, attributes, repeats and simple data.

levels.title: Tens Trail
levels.purpose: Coordinate two-digit order, place value, skip patterns and facts.

levels.title: Fact Trail
levels.purpose: Use inverse relations, equal groups, fractions, measures and coins.

levels.title: Everyday Trail
levels.purpose: Bridge ten and apply two-digit ideas to money, space and data.

levels.title: Hundreds Trail
levels.purpose: Represent and calculate with three-digit place value.

levels.title: Group and Share
levels.purpose: Connect multiplication, division, fractions, money and time.

levels.title: Measure and Evidence
levels.purpose: Use place-value shifts, metric contexts, space and investigation.

levels.title: Thousands Trail
levels.purpose: Scale whole-number order, rounding, regrouping and facts.

levels.title: Product and Fraction Lab
levels.purpose: Link larger products, division, fractions, equations and rules.

levels.title: Map and Investigation Field
levels.purpose: Apply money, time, metric, geometric and evidence reasoning.

levels.title: Decimal Bridge
levels.purpose: Use large-number structure, efficient operations and parity.

levels.title: Equivalent Measures
levels.purpose: Connect fraction equivalence, decimals, equations, instruments and finance.

levels.title: Area and Evidence Studio
levels.purpose: Use algorithms, area, transformations, scaled data and chance.

levels.title: Factor Summit
levels.purpose: Coordinate extended number scales, estimation, factors and large operations.

levels.title: Rational Model Workshop
levels.purpose: Operate with rational forms, finance, variables and metric conversions.

levels.title: Metric Observatory
levels.purpose: Integrate area, volume, time, angle, coordinates and evidence.

designRationales.claim: Small-set perception and one-to-one coordination precede reliable symbolic work.
Part-whole images bridge number, fractions, decimals and operations.
Patterns, equality, factors and inverse links grow as one relationship strand.
Operation meanings are grounded in situations before efficient calculation is expected.
Direct comparison precedes unit iteration, scaled instruments and metric conversion.
Movement and construction precede property language, coordinates and transformations.
Sorting and one-to-one records precede scaled displays, investigations and uncertainty claims.

skills.title: Pair Each Object
skills.objective: Match every item in one small collection with one item in another.

skills.title: Count a Set to Three
skills.objective: Touch or move each object once to find a total through three.

skills.title: Compare Tiny Sets
skills.objective: Use pairing to decide which set has more, fewer or the same amount.

skills.title: Continue an AB Repeat
skills.objective: Choose the next item or action in a two-part repeating pattern.

skills.title: Match Familiar Shapes
skills.objective: Match circles, triangles, squares and rectangles despite changes in colour, size or turn.

skills.title: Compare Two Event Durations
skills.objective: Compare the durations of two familiar events when the difference is clear.

skills.title: Sort by One Feature
skills.objective: Sort familiar objects into two or three categories using one stated attribute.

skills.title: Count a Set to Five
skills.objective: Coordinate one count word with each object and state the total through five.

skills.title: Recognize Structured Sets to Three
skills.objective: Match a displayed dice or frame pattern through three to its number.

skills.title: Order Zero to Five
skills.objective: Place numeral cards from zero through five in sequence and connect each to a set.

skills.title: Make a Small Whole Two Ways
skills.objective: Split and recombine a quantity through five in at least two part pairs.

skills.title: Compare One Attribute Directly
skills.objective: Compare two objects for length, mass or capacity without a numbered scale.

skills.title: Show One Joining
skills.objective: Act out adding one object and find the new total.

skills.title: Show One Leaving
skills.objective: Act out removing one object and find how many remain.

skills.title: Share Small Sets Fairly
skills.objective: Deal through six objects between two recipients and decide whether shares are equal.

skills.title: Copy a Three-Part Repeat
skills.objective: Copy and continue an AAB, ABB or ABC repeating unit.

skills.title: Place It by a Landmark
skills.objective: Act on in, on, under, beside and between using a visible landmark.

skills.title: Record a Two-Group Sort
skills.objective: Sort a displayed collection into two categories and determine its one-mark-per-item record.

skills.title: Connect Numbers Zero to Ten
skills.objective: Match number names, numerals, positions and collections from zero through ten.

skills.title: Recognize Structured Sets to Five
skills.objective: Match a displayed dice or five-frame pattern through five to its number.

skills.title: Compare Collections to Ten
skills.objective: Compare two collections through ten and justify with pairing, counting or a frame.

skills.title: Recall Parts of Five
skills.objective: Name a missing part when a whole through five and the other part are shown.

skills.title: Build and Break Ten
skills.objective: Compose and decompose quantities through ten with two labelled parts.

skills.title: Classify Familiar Shapes and Solids
skills.objective: Classify familiar flat shapes and solids by one visible property.

skills.title: Order Numbers Zero to Twenty
skills.objective: Place, read and locate numbers from zero through twenty on a track or line.

skills.title: See Ten Inside Teen Numbers
skills.objective: Represent eleven through nineteen as one ten and some ones.

skills.title: Find One More or Less
skills.objective: Find the number one greater or one smaller within zero through twenty.

skills.title: Write Joining Equations to Ten
skills.objective: Choose or write an addition equation matching a joining model within ten.

skills.title: Write Leaving Equations to Ten
skills.objective: Choose or write a subtraction equation matching a take-away model within ten.

skills.title: Make Two Equal Halves
skills.objective: Divide a shape or even collection into two equal parts and identify one part.

skills.title: Read and Form Numerals to Twenty
skills.objective: Read a shown numeral and form the numeral for a spoken number through twenty.

skills.title: Make Equal Groups to Ten
skills.objective: Arrange through ten objects into equal groups or shares and describe the structure.

skills.title: Continue a Marked Repeating Unit
skills.objective: Continue an AAB, ABB or ABC repeating pattern when its repeating unit is marked.

skills.title: Follow a Short Route
skills.objective: Follow two position or direction instructions in a familiar picture or play space.

skills.title: Explain a Direct Comparison
skills.objective: Compare length, mass, capacity or duration and name the attribute used.

skills.title: Display Two Shown Categories
skills.objective: Represent two displayed categories with one mark per object.

skills.title: Read and Order to One Hundred Twenty
skills.objective: Represent, compare and order whole numbers through one hundred twenty.

skills.title: Partition Two-Digit Numbers
skills.objective: Build a two-digit number as tens and ones and write its expanded parts.

skills.title: Count in Twos Fives and Tens
skills.objective: Continue forward and backward skip sequences within one hundred twenty.

skills.title: Add Within Twenty
skills.objective: Find sums within twenty by counting on, making ten or using a known bond.

skills.title: Subtract Within Twenty
skills.objective: Find differences within twenty by counting back, counting up or using a known bond.

skills.title: Read Hour and Half Hour
skills.objective: Read analogue clocks at hour and half-hour times.

skills.title: Build an Add-Subtract Family
skills.objective: Write related addition and subtraction equations for one part-part-whole model.

skills.title: Balance a Missing Part
skills.objective: Find a missing addend or subtrahend within twenty while preserving equality.

skills.title: Make Equal Groups and Shares
skills.objective: Represent equal grouping and sharing situations and write matching number statements.

skills.title: Measure with Equal Informal Units
skills.objective: Measure a length by laying equal units end to end with no gaps or overlaps.

skills.title: Find Halves and Quarters
skills.objective: Split a shape or even collection into two or four equal parts and name one part.

skills.title: Recognize Canadian Coin Values
skills.objective: Identify Canadian 5-cent, 10-cent, 25-cent, 1-dollar and 2-dollar coin values without size cues.

skills.title: Bridge Ten for Add and Subtract
skills.objective: Use a make-ten or through-ten strategy for one-digit facts that cross ten.

skills.title: Repartition a Two-Digit Number
skills.objective: Show standard tens and ones and one different valid partition for a two-digit number.

skills.title: Match Equivalent Coin Amounts
skills.objective: Complete an equivalent Canadian coin combination for a multiple-of-five amount through one dollar.

skills.title: Classify Flat Shapes and Solids
skills.objective: Sort common two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional objects by named features.

skills.title: Give and Follow Directions
skills.objective: Give or follow up to four movement and turn instructions in a familiar grid.

skills.title: Make a One-to-One Data Display
skills.objective: Build and compare one-to-one frequency records from a shown categorical response list.

skills.title: Read and Order to One Thousand
skills.objective: Read, represent, compare and order whole numbers through one thousand.

skills.title: Partition and Rename Three Digits
skills.objective: Partition a three-digit number into hundreds, tens and ones in standard and equivalent forms.

skills.title: Compare Positions to One Thousand
skills.objective: Compare the positions of two three-digit numbers on a marked or partly marked number line.

skills.title: Recall Facts Within Twenty
skills.objective: Recall addition and subtraction facts within twenty and use inverse facts to check.

skills.title: Add Two-Digit Numbers
skills.objective: Add two two-digit numbers with place-value partitioning and optional regrouping.

skills.title: Subtract Two-Digit Numbers
skills.objective: Subtract two-digit numbers with place-value partitioning and optional regrouping.

skills.title: Recall Two Times Facts
skills.objective: Represent and recall multiplication facts with a factor of two and connect them to doubles.

skills.title: Recall Five and Ten Times Facts
skills.objective: Represent and recall multiplication facts with a factor of five or ten.

skills.title: Link Multiplication and Division
skills.objective: Use arrays or equal groups to write related multiplication and division equations.

skills.title: Partition Halves Quarters and Eighths
skills.objective: Represent one or several equal parts of shapes, lengths or collections.

skills.title: Find Canadian Coin Change
skills.objective: Find change from a stated amount paid for a multiple-of-five Canadian price through five dollars.

skills.title: Read Quarter-Hour Clocks
skills.objective: Read analogue times at quarter-hour intervals.

skills.title: Shift by One Ten or Hundred
skills.objective: Mentally add or subtract one, ten or one hundred within one thousand.

skills.title: Continue an Additive Rule
skills.objective: Continue an increasing or decreasing constant-step sequence and fill one missing term.

skills.title: Choose and Use Early Metric Units
skills.objective: Choose and use centimetres, metres, grams, kilograms, millilitres or litres in familiar measures.

skills.title: Describe Shape Features
skills.objective: Describe common flat shapes and solids using sides, vertices, edges, faces and surfaces.

skills.title: Read a Simple Map Route
skills.objective: Use a key and position language to follow or describe a route on a simple map.

skills.title: Build and Interpret a Survey Display
skills.objective: Build a tally or one-to-one picture graph from shown categorical survey responses and identify the most or least frequent category.

skills.title: Read and Order beyond Ten Thousand
skills.objective: Read, represent, compare and order natural numbers through fifty thousand.

skills.title: Partition Four- and Five-Digit Numbers
skills.objective: Partition, rearrange and rename numbers through fifty thousand using powers of ten.

skills.title: Round to Tens and Hundreds
skills.objective: Round a whole number to the nearest ten or hundred using bounding multiples.

skills.title: Add and Subtract Three Digits
skills.objective: Calculate with two- and three-digit numbers using partitioning and regrouping.

skills.title: Recall Three Four and Eight Times Facts
skills.objective: Recall facts with factors three, four and eight using grouping and doubling links.

skills.title: Use Related Division Facts
skills.objective: Find quotients from known multiplication facts for twos, threes, fours, fives, eights and tens.

skills.title: Multiply Two Digits by One Digit
skills.objective: Multiply a two-digit whole number by one digit using partitioning, an array or written layout.

skills.title: Divide Two Digits with Remainders
skills.objective: Divide a two-digit number by one digit and show quotient and remainder in context.

skills.title: Compare Proper Fractions
skills.objective: Compare proper unit and non-unit fractions from zero to one using fraction models.

skills.title: Add and Subtract Like Fractions within One
skills.objective: Add or subtract fractions with a shared denominator when the result stays from zero to one.

skills.title: Solve Additive Unknown Equations
skills.objective: Find an unknown in a one-step addition or subtraction equation using inverse reasoning.

skills.title: Extend Number-Rule Patterns
skills.objective: Extend short addition, subtraction and multiplication number patterns.

skills.title: Find Change from Canadian Prices
skills.objective: Find change from a whole-dollar payment for a multiple-of-five Canadian price.

skills.title: Read Time to the Minute
skills.objective: Read analogue and digital time to the minute and find a duration within one hour.

skills.title: Find Metric Perimeter
skills.objective: Measure side lengths and calculate the perimeter of a polygon in centimetres or metres.

skills.title: Classify Shapes by Angle and Line Properties
skills.objective: Classify flat shapes using right-angle, parallel and perpendicular properties.

skills.title: Locate Places on a Grid Map
skills.objective: Use a labelled square grid, key and route clues to locate and describe positions.

skills.title: Compare Repeated Chance Runs
skills.objective: Compare outcome frequencies from two repeated runs of the same chance experiment.

skills.title: Read and Order to One Hundred Thousand
skills.objective: Read, represent, compare and order whole numbers through one hundred thousand.

skills.title: Scale Whole Numbers by Ten and One Hundred
skills.objective: Use place value to multiply a whole number by ten or one hundred.

skills.title: Round to Ten Hundred or Thousand
skills.objective: Round a whole number to the requested ten, hundred or thousand place.

skills.title: Read Negative Values in Context
skills.objective: Locate and compare negative and positive whole numbers on temperature or elevation scales.

skills.title: Add and Subtract Multi-Digit Numbers
skills.objective: Choose efficient mental or written strategies for whole-number addition and subtraction to four digits.

skills.title: Multiply Three Digits by One Digit
skills.objective: Multiply a whole number through three digits by one digit using known facts through twelve.

skills.title: Use Odd and Even Properties
skills.objective: Predict and explain parity of sums, differences and products.

skills.title: Generate Equivalent Fractions
skills.objective: Use scaling or a visual model to generate and verify equivalent fractions.

skills.title: Connect Tenths Hundredths and Decimals
skills.objective: Connect tenths and hundredths written as fractions and decimals from zero to one.

skills.title: Compare Decimals to Hundredths
skills.objective: Compare and order decimals through two places, including values greater than one.

skills.title: Solve Multi-Digit Additive Equations
skills.objective: Find an unknown in an addition or subtraction equation and justify the inverse used.

skills.title: Solve Canadian Purchases and Change
skills.objective: Solve a one- or two-step Canadian purchase or change problem.

skills.title: Extend Addition and Multiplication Patterns
skills.objective: Extend number patterns generated by one addition or multiplication rule.

skills.title: Operate with Fractions beyond One
skills.objective: Add or subtract common-denominator fractions, including results beyond one.

skills.title: Find Rectangle Area
skills.objective: Determine the area of a rectangle by covering or calculating equal square units.

skills.title: Explore Line and Rotational Symmetry
skills.objective: Identify and complete line or rotational symmetry in a flat figure.

skills.title: Plan and Display a Scaled Survey
skills.objective: Plan a categorical or discrete survey and choose a many-to-one display to describe variation.

skills.title: Test Whether Chance Trials Depend
skills.objective: Decide whether successive trials are independent or dependent in a stated chance experiment.

skills.title: Order Contextual Integers
skills.objective: Compare and order contextual integers from negative one hundred through positive one million.

skills.title: Order Decimals to Thousandths
skills.objective: Compare and order decimals greater than one through three decimal places.

skills.title: Round Estimate and Check
skills.objective: Judge whether a calculation is plausible by using a stated rounding or compatible-number estimate.

skills.title: Classify Factor Structure
skills.objective: Classify a whole number through one hundred as prime, composite, square or cube using its factors.

skills.title: Multiply Large Numbers
skills.objective: Multiply a whole number through four digits by a one- or two-digit whole number.

skills.title: Divide Large Numbers and Interpret Remainders
skills.objective: Divide through four digits by one digit and interpret the remainder for the context.

skills.title: Operate with Related-Denominator Fractions
skills.objective: Add or subtract fractions with equal or factor-related denominators.

skills.title: Convert Common Percents Fractions and Decimals
skills.objective: Convert common percentages to equivalent fractions and decimals.

skills.title: Add and Subtract Decimals
skills.objective: Add or subtract decimals through three places.

skills.title: Build a Canadian Budget Model
skills.objective: Solve a multi-step Canadian budget or total-cost problem using a numeric money model.

skills.title: Use a One-Variable Rule
skills.objective: Write and evaluate a one-variable expression for a one-step number pattern.

skills.title: Choose and Convert Metric Units
skills.objective: Convert between two units in one metric length, mass or capacity family using a power of ten.

skills.title: Find Composite Rectilinear Area
skills.objective: Determine the area of a composite rectilinear shape by decomposing it into rectangles.

skills.title: Find Rectangular-Prism Volume
skills.objective: Determine the volume of a rectangular prism by counting or multiplying unit-cube layers.

skills.title: Find a Timetable Interval
skills.objective: Calculate one timetable interval of up to two days using 12- or 24-hour notation.

skills.title: Measure Angles
skills.objective: Measure a given angle from zero to one hundred eighty degrees.

skills.title: Translate Points on a Coordinate Grid
skills.objective: Describe a translation of a plotted point on a first-quadrant coordinate grid.

skills.title: Interpret Comparative Data Displays
skills.objective: Interpret a line graph or comparative display by describing its mode and overall shape.
